note: Historical evidence used by cycle-report.js for gate G0. Each entry cites where the number comes from. Numbers are copied from docs/STUDY-GUIDE.md; when a source gives several values the LEAST negative one is used, so a rejection never rests on a worst-case pick.

v5.label: Momentum V5 (paper)

hist.source: STUDY-GUIDE decision log 6 Oct: intraday-lab, parameters fixed before the run, 528k signals; score 70+: setup A -0.111R, B -0.185R, C -0.130R, every setup loses in development and holdout, t(day) -10 to -30

v5.caveat: The lab tests the signal rules on every stock. V5's live pre-market ranking and news layer are not replayed historically; only live trades can show whether they change the sign.

hist.source: STUDY-GUIDE section 3: 494 sessions, 387 trades, -0.08R after charges; all-stocks version 9,841 trades -0.166R (signal before charges -0.026R); search for a selection rule found none

iss.label: ISS intraday short straddle (paper, real option quotes)
iss.requirement: Only a Black-Scholes model exists (it passes the frozen rule but a calendar clock gives -104% a year, so the result depends on the clock and the volatility scale). Needs at least 30 forward trades on real quotes, stable across clock assumptions, with worst-day loss within the approved limit. Margin per straddle (reference Rs 2,00,000) must fit verified real capital.

fno.label: F&O weekly NIFTY iron condor (paper)
fno.requirement: Its risk is a rare large loss, so a few weeks prove nothing. Needs at least 30 expiries (about 7 months), the stop shown to work, and chain data complete.

swing.label: Swing momentum portfolio (paper)
swing.requirement: 10-year daily test: 21.8% a year against Nifty 9.0%, but on today's Nifty 200 only (survivorship) and not proven better than holding the same stocks equally (+0.27% a month, interval includes zero). One decision a month: cannot be judged by results for years.

ml.label: ML models (research, ml-trading repo)

hist.source: EXP-B-001: every candidate lost 13.7 to 14.7 bps per trade net (gross edge under 1 bp); earlier information tests the same. Value shown is in R-equivalent only for the table; the real figure is -13.7 bps

ml.requirement: Frozen shadow model collecting forward data (not yet running); gate of 120 valid days with day-clustered intervals above zero (docs/SHADOW.md).
